timings.scope: One fixed package, 5 MiB generated fixture, 200 headings/cards and 500 attached highlights. New process and isolated profile each run; OS file cache is not flushed.
timings.featurePolicy: default never invokes an AX setter. observed adds webContents and extendedProperties to every existing feature. No feature is removed; the process is destroyed after the sample.
timings.tracePolicy: Trace mode is one separate observed sample with profiling and discovered accessibility trace categories; no timing budget is evaluated for it.

summary.note: These are controlled process feature flags, not proof of behavior with any particular native assistive client. All observations and overruns remain; event names and native/JS attribution require inspection of the separate trace.
